observations: Three photos show two identical car headlight assemblies lying on a concrete floor.
Each headlight has a clear lens, a circular main bulb housing, and an amber turn signal section on the lower left.
The housing is black plastic with a red trim strip along the top edge.
The design is consistent across all three photos, suggesting they are the same unit.
No visible brand or model markings are readable on the headlight assemblies themselves.
The watermark 'LINUS AUTO - LIGHT SOLUTION' is present on all photos, indicating the seller's name or business.
The headlamps appear clean and undamaged in the photos, with no obvious cracks or fogging.

claims.claim: Contact us for your Honda front and back lights all models available
claims.evidence: The photos show only front headlights; no back lights are visible. The claim about Honda is not supported by the photos, as no Honda branding or model-specific features are visible. The seller's text is not proof of the item's identity or compatibility.

risks.risk: The headlamps may not be compatible with Honda vehicles, or may be for a different model than claimed.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the back of the headlamps showing part numbers, model codes, or a label indicating compatibility with Honda models.
risks.if_unproven: priced as generic front headlights, not Honda-specific

risks.risk: The headlamps may be damaged or non-functional (e.g., broken bulbs, cracked lenses, or internal wiring issues).
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the bulb sockets, internal components, and wiring harness, showing no damage or loose parts.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially non-functional or damaged

risks.risk: The headlamps may be counterfeit or low-quality aftermarket parts.
risks.proof: A photo of the part number or barcode label on the back of the headlamps, or a comparison with official Honda parts.
risks.if_unproven: priced as generic or aftermarket, not official Honda parts

proof_requests: A clear photo of the back of the headlamps showing part numbers or model codes.
A close-up of the bulb sockets and internal components to check for damage.
Confirmation of compatibility with Honda vehicles, if any.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
